integrity: All finite modular certificates checked by standalone exact integer arithmetic; convergence is an elementary proof independent of finite tests; literature comparison is best-knowledge and independent validation has not occurred.
limitations: Proves existence of a 13-term block, not its maximal possible length; theta limit is for odd prime extension degrees only; no optimality of convergence rate. Prior implicit prime-subfield lifting cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Thirteen consecutive nonprimitive nonsquares at asymptotically maximal primitive density
